{{Top|leg}}
A '''tactical villip''' was a type of [[villip]] used by higher ranking [[Yuuzhan Vong]] warriors as the equivalent of real-time audiovisual communicators. Yuuzhan Vong battle masters made use of a master villip that provided information from subordinates' villips.
